scene: 研究室の机で、保管試料と照合試料の封筒を両手に持ち、同一個体だと確信する研究者（CHAR-07）。

She holds one plain brown envelope in each hand side by side in front of her chest, eyebrows raised high, eyes wide and certain, mouth open in a firm declaration, a bead of sweat on her temple, convinced and firm, NOT calm, NOT smiling. No lettering on the envelopes, no badge, no logo, no name tag. Only this one woman, no other people. Do NOT draw her with realistic adult proportions — not four, five, six or seven heads tall. Full body. Transparent background, real alpha transparency. 1:1 aspect ratio. Generate 1 image.
